'''Justicar Maintenance''' was an area in the [[Justicar territory|territory]] of the [[Justicars' Brigade]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Located near the entrance to [[The Works/Legends|the Works]] industrial sector, the area was home to most of Justicar territory's maintenance systems and controls. A clan of [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] had a workshop there.
